title: Hotels Near Vejthani Hospital, Bangkok 2026 — 7 Closest Stays + Booking Links | ThailandAddict
metaDesc: The 7 closest hotels to Vejthani Hospital in Bangkok — each with the real walking or driving distance to Vejthani, what it's best for, approximate starting prices and booking links. Made for patients and their families.
ogDesc: The 7 closest stays to Vejthani, with real distances and prices.
intro: Vejthani is a private hospital that draws a lot of international patients, especially for orthopaedics. It stands on Soi Lat Phrao 111 in Khlong Chan, Bangkapi, on Bangkok's east side. The first thing to understand is that this is a residential area, not a hotel district like Sukhumvit, so most stays here are serviced apartments and budget hotels built for longer visits. The closest and most convenient option for patient families is 111 Residence, run by the hospital right next door — you can walk across. The rest sit on the nearby Soi Lat Phrao 117 and 130, a few minutes by taxi or car. The trade-off is the distance from the main sights; the nearest train is the MRT Yellow Line along Lat Phrao, and Lat Phrao Road jams up at rush hour.

blocks.html: Short answer: Vejthani sits at the mouth of Soi Lat Phrao 111 in Khlong Chan, Bangkapi. The one place you can genuinely walk to is the hospital's own 111 Residence right next door. Around it, Soi Lat Phrao 117 and Soi Lat Phrao 130 hold several more hotels and serviced apartments that are a few minutes' drive away. Rooms start around ฿600 and rise to about ฿1,800 at 111 Residence.

blocks.text: Hotels near Vejthani, by distance & budget

items.name: Synsiri Ladprao 130
items.meta: 📍 5-min drive (1.5 km) to Vejthani · ★ 3-star · Best for: Tightest budget · longer stays · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A cheap serviced apartment on Soi Lat Phrao 130 in Khlong Chan, on the same side as Soi 111 and a few minutes' drive from Vejthani. It has 85 rooms with a restaurant and laundry service, suiting anyone keeping the budget as low as possible over several nights. To be straight, reviews are mixed — some praise the location and value, others complain about room condition and service, so check recent photos and reviews before booking.

items.name: Baron Zotel Bangkok
items.meta: 📍 5-min drive (1.2 km) to Vejthani · ★ 3-star · Best for: Good value · close to the hospital · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A small, low-key hotel at 77 Soi Lat Phrao 117 in Khlong Chan, about 1.2 km from Vejthani — a few minutes by car (or roughly a 15-minute walk if it's not too hot). It has a rooftop restaurant-bar, clean rooms with balconies, and free Wi-Fi, and scores around 4 stars across 800-plus reviews for friendly English-speaking staff, clean rooms, and low prices. It's a fit for patient families who want a value room near the hospital. Worth knowing: it has few rooms and sits inside a soi.

items.name: Baron Residence Bangkok
items.meta: 📍 4-min drive (1 km) to Vejthani · ★ 4-star · Best for: Rooms with a balcony · value longer stays · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: An 87-room serviced apartment on Soi Lat Phrao 130 (Ramkhamhaeng 81) in Khlong Chan, about a 4-minute drive from Vejthani. Rooms come with a balcony, air-con, a fridge, and a safe, plus a restaurant, free parking, and free Wi-Fi. Reviews praise the comfortable beds, clean rooms, good service, and value, making it a fit for multi-night stays wanting a balcony room on a budget. Worth knowing: it sits deep in a soi and far from the sights.

items.name: 130 Hotel & Residence Bangkok
items.meta: 📍 4-min drive (1 km) to Vejthani · ★ 4-star · Best for: Clean newer rooms · good breakfast · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A hotel-and-residence on Soi Lat Phrao 130 in Khlong Chan, about a 4-minute drive from Vejthani. It scores around 8.0 across 500-plus reviews, standing out for cleanliness, value, and helpful staff, with a restaurant, a gym, and free Wi-Fi. Many guests mention a decent breakfast buffet, making it a fit for patient families who want a clean room for a longer stay. The honest trade-off is the location deep in a soi, the distance from the sights, and Lat Phrao Road's rush-hour traffic.

items.name: Livotel Hotel Lat Phrao Bangkok
items.meta: 📍 5-min drive (0.8 km) to Vejthani · ★ 4-star · Best for: Full hotel · closest hotel to Vejthani · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A 4-star, 111-room hotel at 707 Soi Lat Phrao 130 (Ramkhamhaeng 81) in Khlong Chan, about 0.8 km from Vejthani — a few minutes by taxi. It's the most complete hotel among the close options, with a restaurant, a coffee shop, free Wi-Fi, and free parking. Reviews praise the clean, comfortable rooms, the value, and the link to the MRT Yellow Line, making it a fit for anyone who wants real hotel service near the hospital. Worth knowing: it sits in a soi and is far from the sights.

items.name: SC Park Hotel
items.meta: 📍 12-min drive (3.5 km) to Vejthani · ★ 4-star · Best for: Has a pool · some rooms with a kitchenette · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A 4-star, 175-room hotel at 474 Soi Ramkhamhaeng 39 (Thepleela) in Wang Thonglang, about a 12-minute drive from Vejthani. It's farther out than the Lat Phrao soi cluster but comes with fuller facilities — an outdoor pool, a gym, a sauna, and on-site restaurants — and some rooms have a kitchenette and dining area. It suits families or longer stays wanting a pool and more space. Worth knowing: reviews are mixed, with some noting a musty smell and bathroom cleanliness, and it's farther from Vejthani than the others, so budget driving time.

items.name: 111 Residence
items.meta: 📍 2-min walk (next to the hospital) to Vejthani · ★ 3-star · Best for: Patient families · longer recovery stays · walk to the wards · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: The serviced apartment run by Vejthani itself, right next to the hospital on Soi Lat Phrao 111 — you can walk across to the wards. The draw is the proximity and convenience for patients and families who come and go often or are in for a long recovery. It has several room sizes from Superior, Deluxe, and VIP up to family rooms and a villa. The Superior runs about ฿1,800 at the standard rate, with 10% off every stay, 20% off for stays over 4 nights, and 25% off for stays over a month, which makes it well suited to long recovery stays. One key point: you book directly with 111 Residence through the hospital — it is not sold on Agoda or Booking.

faq.q: Is there anywhere within walking distance of Vejthani?
faq.a: Really just one: 111 Residence, run by the hospital, sits right next door on Soi Lat Phrao 111, and you can walk across to the wards. The others — Baron Zotel on Soi Lat Phrao 117 and the cluster on Soi Lat Phrao 130 (Livotel, Baron Residence, 130 Hotel) — are about a kilometre away, a few minutes by car or taxi. You can walk it, but budget for the sun and traffic. If you'll be in and out of the hospital often or are in for a long recovery, 111 Residence is the most convenient.

faq.q: I'm here for a long recovery of several weeks — what should I pick?
faq.a: Go for a serviced apartment built for long stays: you get a larger room, some have a kitchenette or pantry corner, and many discount for longer bookings. 111 Residence gives 20% off over 4 nights and 25% off over a month and is the most direct choice since it's attached to the hospital. If you want a pool and more space even though it's farther, SC Park has some rooms with a kitchenette. The Soi Lat Phrao 130 cluster, like Baron Residence and 130 Hotel, also suits multi-night stays at good value.

faq.q: What's there to eat near Vejthani, and how do you get into the city?
faq.a: This is a residential area; around the hospital and along Soi Lat Phrao 111–130 you'll find rice-and-curry shops, convenience stores, and markets. The nearest big mall is The Mall Lifestore Bangkapi, a few minutes' drive, with plenty of restaurants and a supermarket. To reach the centre, use the MRT Yellow Line along Lat Phrao Road, which connects to the Blue Line, but the station isn't right by the hospital, so you'll take a taxi or motorbike taxi to it — and Lat Phrao Road is congested at rush hour, so leave extra time.
